ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of the input composition of three types of factories A, B, and C in items such as wages, fuel costs, raw materials, transportation costs, technology, and others. Type C factory corresponds to the diagonal-line bar. From the figure, C has the highest bar height in the “wages” item, accounting for about 40%; the “technology” input bar is relatively low, clearly not dominated by technology input. Then reason: The highest proportion of wage input indicates that type C factory depends greatly on labor costs and belongs to labor-oriented industry. At the present stage, China’s central and western regions have relatively abundant labor and relatively low wage levels, making them suitable for the layout of labor-oriented factories. Therefore, type C factory is suitable to be located in China’s central and western regions.
